page.heading: Supplier Subscriptions
page.caption: Supplier subscription management
page.caption_inactive: View inactive or expired supplier subscriptions

empty.title: No supplier subscriptions found
empty.active_message: Create your first supplier subscription to get started.
empty.inactive_message: Inactive or expired supplier subscriptions will appear here.

form.name: Subscription Name
form.start_time_info: Optional time of day in the operator's display timezone. Leave blank for start of day (00:00).
form.end_time_info: Optional time of day in the operator's display timezone. Leave blank for end of day (23:59).
form.auto_renew_hint: When enabled, an operator can extend this subscription at term end. No automatic renewal — the operator clicks Renew to extend the end date.
form.supplier_info: The supplier this subscription is with.
form.cost_plan_info: The cost plan governing this subscription. Determines billing amount, cycle, and billing currency.
form.code_info: Short reference for this subscription. Leave blank to auto-generate.
form.start_date_info: First day this subscription is active. Billing cycles are counted from this date.
form.end_date_info: Last day this subscription is active. Leave blank for open-ended.
form.start_date_row_help: Start date affects which cost plans are available — only cost plans active in this date range can be selected.
form.end_date_row_help: End date controls when recurring expenditures stop being generated. Leave blank for open-ended billing.
form.notes_info: Internal remarks — shown on detail pages but not on supplier-facing documents.

recognitions.name: Name
recognitions.empty_message: Expense recognitions linked to this subscription will appear here.

confirm.delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete this supplier subscription? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.bulk_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete the selected supplier subscriptions? This action cannot be undone.

errors.cannot_delete: Cannot delete — this subscription has dependent records
